kjv: I charge [thee] therefore before God, and the Lord Jesus Christ, who shall judge
mine: I charge you in the presence of God and of Christ Jesus, Who is to judge
note: TR adds "oun ego" and "tou kyriou"; and reads "kata" (at his appearing) for "kai" (and by his appearing).

kjv: The Lord Jesus Christ [be] with thy spirit. Grace [be] with you. Amen.
mine: The Lord be with your spirit. Grace be with you.
note: TR adds "Jesus Christ" and "Amen"; absent from Sinaiticus*, F, G.
